title: SQL HAVING Clause
text:
SQL
HAVING
Clause



The SQL HAVING Clause

The
HAVING
clause is used to filter the results of a
GROUP BY
query based on aggregate functions.
Unlike the
WHERE
clause, which filters individual rows before grouping,
HAVING

filters groups after the aggregation has been performed.

HAVING Syntax

SELECT
column1, aggregate_function(column2), column3, ...

FROM
table_name

WHERE
condition

GROUP BY
column1
,
column3

HAVING
condition
-- The condition on grouped data

ORDER BY
column_name
;
